violations.description: Tests exist but no CI workflow runs them.
violations.evidence: Tests exist in tests/ (test_basic.py, test_advanced.py) and a Makefile runs `nosetests tests`, but there is no .github/workflows/, .travis.yml, .circleci/, .gitlab-ci.yml, Jenkinsfile, or other CI configuration.
violations.recommendation: Add a CI workflow (e.g., GitHub Actions) that runs the test suite on pushes and pull requests to the default branch.

violations.description: Test contains a meaningless assertion (`assert True`) that verifies nothing.
violations.evidence: In tests/test_basic.py line 12: `assert True` - this test always passes and tests no actual functionality.
violations.recommendation: Replace the placeholder test with meaningful assertions that verify actual behavior of the code under test.
